item.title: Honest Opinions on Linux Distros
item.description:
My rating of Linux distros

1. Void Linux

Void linux is #1 only because it doesn’t use systemd as an init system… Okay also because of it’s blazingly fast package manager… And customizability also >~< I don’t know why, it might be because you build it to your needs, but I find it very snappy and comfortable to use. I for some reason really like it, and I can’t really explain why.

item.title: My Story With ThinkPads
item.description:
How I Got Into Thinkpads

I’ve been a Linux user for quite some time now, and it’s impossible to be a Linux die-hard without encountering ThinkPads. My journey with ThinkPads began several years ago when I got my first one, a ThinkPad T480.

My ThinkPad T480

This is where my ThinkPad adventure began. The T480 is an excellent laptop, in fact, I’m writing this part on it right now!

It’s built like a tank, but not a big tank, a relatively slim, portable tank (compared to the T420). And it has a fantastic keyboard, as all older ThinkPads do.

item.title: Vege Dreams: My Vegetarian Recipe Collection
item.description:
Vegetarian Recipes!

It would make me very happy, if you checked out my vegetarian recipe collection website called Vege Dreams.

It’s a personal project of mine, where I share my favorite vegetarian recipes that I have tried and loved over the years. From Irish soda bread to Italian Spaghetti Carboanara (without bacon, of course!), there’s something for everyone.

What can you find there?

You can also find some vegan recipes there, and some recipes are very easy to adapt to be vegan-friendly, usually just remove cheese, or replace dairy with plant-based alternatives.

item.title: Making this website
item.description:
Making this website

I have made my first ever website when I was in 6th grade in primary school (I was 11). It was a very simple website made with, very coincidentally… Hugo!

How did I start?

Hugo was introduced to me by my brother, who already had some experience with it, so he set me up with a very basic template and I got to work. You can still find the website on GitHub. It’s actually my first ever GitHub repository!
